newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan changes 50,000 T gasoline delivery period.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan changes 50,000 T gasoline delivery period.

text.p: Pakistan's Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources said on Tuesday it had brought forward the delivery date for 50,000 tonnes of motor gasoline to May, instead of 25,000 tonnes each in May and June.
"The requirement of one cargo each in May and June, 1997 shown in the tender documents, may please be read as two cargoes for the month of May," a ministry statement said.

The ministry had invited bids on March 11 for the supply of 50,000 tonnes of motor gasoline 80 and 87 RON for delivery in May and June. Motor gasoline suppliers must submit their bids by March 31. They must be valid until April 5.
